title: CreditTransaction
description: One movement of credit on an account, written once and never changed. The balance on the account is the sum of these; a row kept after the fact is what makes it possible to say why.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

account.description: The id of the account the credit moved on, in the system that holds it.

amount.description: Signed: negative spends, positive tops up or refills. One field rather than a direction and a magnitude, so adding them up needs no rules.

balanceAfter.description: The balance the moment after this movement was applied. Copied here on purpose: reading a balance as of some past row should not mean replaying the whole ledger.

operation.description: What caused the movement, in the words of the system that charged for it. Free text: the list of billable operations belongs to that system.

reference.description: The id of the job or generation that caused it, in the system that owns that thing. Absent for a refill or a top-up, which answer to nothing.

description.description: A line a person can read on a receipt or in support. Written by whoever charged; empty when nobody wrote one.
